title: Desk Authority and Service Limits for Rental Vehicle Coordination Settlement
content:
Rental Vehicle Coordination settles every class on the same service limits: the final invoice is settled within 3 business days after return, an overpayment is refunded within 5 business days, and the desk may credit as goodwill on one rental at most 1 rental day at the class's partner rate.

## Limits by class

| Rental class | Settlement of the final invoice (business days after return) | Refund of an overpayment (business days) | Goodwill credit authority (rental days at the class partner rate) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Economy Rental | 3 | 5 | 1 |
| Compact Rental | 3 | 5 | 1 |
| Intermediate Rental | 3 | 5 | 1 |
| Full-Size Rental | 3 | 5 | 1 |
| Standard SUV Rental | 3 | 5 | 1 |
| Minivan Rental | 3 | 5 | 1 |

## Meaning of each limit

- **Settlement**: the business days after return within which the final invoice is settled (a whole number).
- **Refund**: the business days to refund an overpayment (a whole number).
- **Goodwill credit authority**: the most the desk may credit as goodwill on one rental, in rental days at the class's partner rate (a whole number).

## Hypothetical reading

Expressed in money, 1 rental day at the class partner rate is the class's own partner daily rate; for an Economy Rental priced at 39.99 USD per rental day, the goodwill credit authority read from this table is one day's worth, 39.99 USD.
